status: Source coverage map; execution results are recorded separately in the exact-head CI packet.

tests.coverage: Owned resize observers, window listeners and queued animation frames are released, including nested dialog lifetimes.
Positioning listeners/observers and queued frames are disposed without late geometry work.
Queued positioning animation frames are cancelled on unmount.
Shell and status observers disconnect; queued keyboard reveal respects focus ownership.
Owned preview URLs revoke on replacement/cancel/unmount and pending outcomes cannot affect successor drafts.
Concurrent editor URL ownership stays independent and every created URL revokes exactly once.
Editor pending upload, reset and unmount preserve stale-result and host URL ownership boundaries.
Selection geometry observer disconnects and scroll/focus boundaries retain ownership.

limits: Unit doubles verify resource ownership and cancellation, not browser heap attribution or native device behavior.
Repeated production mount/dispose and snapshot review are separate evidence in this directory.
